The documents do not specify the exact address in Schedule 4, but they do show that the address for Voss-Lindqvist AB's General Counsel is in Stockholm, as the engagement letter is addressed to Petra Voss, General Counsel, Voss-Lindqvist AB [3].

evidence.quote: addressed to the General Counsel of the receiving party at the address set out in Schedule 4
To: Petra Voss, General Counsel, Voss-Lindqvist AB — 5 February 2026

items.question: Who will provide the Services after the acquisition of Harrowgate completes?
items.answer: The documents indicate that Harrowgate Systems Inc. will continue to provide the Services after the acquisition completes. The Change of Control notice states, "Harrowgate will continue to provide the Services under the Agreement on its existing terms after completion" [1].

evidence.quote: Harrowgate will continue to provide the Services under the Agreement on its existing terms after completion

items.question: What does Kestrel store for Voss-Lindqvist?
items.answer:
Kestrel stores Voss-Lindqvist AB's archived equipment at its Brookfield facility, as stated in the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement [1].

The monthly storage fee for Voss-Lindqvist AB was initially EUR 4,000, but this was amended to EUR 4,600, effective 1 June 2026 [2].

evidence.quote: Provider will store Client's archived equipment at its Brookfield facility.
Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month.
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: On what date did the Hall 3 chiller fail?
items.answer: The documents do not specify the date when the Hall 3 chiller failed. However, they do state that the temperature alarm sounded on 18 June 2026 [1].

evidence.quote: I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026

items.question: When did Voss-Lindqvist accept the Calder & Wynne engagement letter?
items.answer: The documents indicate that Petra Voss, as the General Counsel for Voss-Lindqvist AB, accepted the Calder & Wynne engagement letter. The acceptance is noted in the engagement letter's clause 8.1, which states: "Accepted for Voss-Lindqvist AB by Petra Voss on 7 February 2026 (fictional)." [2]

evidence.quote: Accepted for Voss-Lindqvist AB by Petra Voss on 7 February 2026 (fictional).

items.question: What must Harrowgate maintain to protect information under the MSA?
items.answer: The documents state that Harrowgate must maintain an information-security programme no less protective than ISO/IEC 27001 to protect information under the MSA [1].

evidence.quote: Provider shall maintain an information-security programme no less protective than ISO/IEC 27001

items.question: Whose consent does the tenant need to assign the whole warehouse lease?
items.answer:
The tenant needs the Landlord's consent to assign the whole warehouse lease.

This is stated in the lease document, which says: "The Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent" [1].

The Landlord is named as Crestmoor Estates Ltd, and the Tenant is Voss-Lindqvist Logistics Ltd in this lease [2].

evidence.quote: The Tenant may assign the whole of the Premises with the Landlord's prior written consent
